question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

Filmmaking involves a number of discrete ___________ including an initial story, idea or commission, through scriptwriting, casting, shooting, editing and screening the finished product before an audience that may result in a film release and exhibition.
solution:
The correct answer is '**stages**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "**stages**".
 
• The sentence is discussing the **various steps involved in the process of filmmaking**.
 
• The word "**discrete**" suggests that **each step is separate and distinct from the others**.
